AgentCompass v0.7.10 updates Antigravity Paseo launches to bare model ids with a separate `thinkingOptionId` (matching `antigravity-resilient` plugin v0.3.0), moves reference data to schema 9, sets the shipped quick-menu defaults to **Carbon**, **Opus 5.5**, and **Astra 6.2**, and bundles tray, router, bridge and audit fixes.

- **Antigravity bare models + `thinkingOptionId`.** Paseo launches `antigravity-resilient` on the bare model id (such as `gemini-4-neon`) with `settings.thinkingOptionId` set from each model's listed `thinkingOptionIds`; models without thinking options (`gemini-pro-orchestrator`, `gpt-oss-120b-medium`) omit `thinkingOptionId`. Direct `agy` CLI callers (`roll` without Paseo, native `invoke_subagent`, Orca, T3) keep naming models `<model>-<effort>` (`account_fleet.agy_cli_model`). Model discovery preserves `thinkingOptionIds`, `auto_bundles` derives one bundle per listed option, named `<model>-<option>` aliases resolve to the bare model at that option, earlier stored bundle choices and active `<model>-<effort>` holds continue to apply, and telemetry reads either `conversationId` or `sessionId`. Model-scoped holds now apply to the bare model across its options, matching Claude and Codex. After updating, refresh the tray model catalog so `~/.agent-compass/model-catalog.json` picks up `thinkingOptionIds`.
- **Data schema 9 and quick-menu defaults.** Reference data moves to schema 9 (`published/9/`; `published/8/` stays untouched for earlier installs) and drops unused schema-8 keys (`defer_if_reset_within_hours`, `needs_judgment_margin`). Shipped quick-menu defaults (`priority_targets`) are set to **Carbon**, **Opus 5.5**, and **Astra 6.2**, with static `carbon_*` bundles on `antigravity`.
- **Router, bridge, audit and tray fixes.** `record` checks the overlaid fleet for free-pool accounts and refuses uncatalogued effort levels when the launch contract offers none; pooled window `refusal_schedule` reports the binding member's reset time; the Paseo bridge stops stuck retry loops on workers bound from an unlabeled state and `reviveRetryWatch` does not overwrite completed receipts; `audit/router_audit.py` classifies `specialist:pro` from `specialty`; the tray unifies `accounts-override.json` path resolution, recognizes legacy `panel:boost` rules in the quick-menu editor, and completes missing English catalog entries.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router/blob/v0.7.10/CHANGELOG.md).

Verified on the released tree: full test suite (`pytest -n auto`: 3071 passed, 5 skipped; one `tray/test_dispatch_notice.py` timing test flaked once under `-n auto` load and passed standalone and in `verify_release.py`); Paseo bridge tests (`node --test`: 116/116); sampled able-to-fail checks on new launch-contract and legacy-hold rules; routing contract and doc tests; `packaging/verify_release.py --with-windows-sandbox` (11/11 PASS: privacy check, foreign-machine check F01 to F13, zero-dispatch check over 13 surfaces, gateway coverage, schema 9 published reference data check against released readers, `setup/`, `scripts/`, `tray/` and `usage-float/` suites, and Windows Sandbox installer/GUI/uninstall check W01). Not verified yet: first real `antigravity-resilient` 0.3.0 dispatch reconcile check for `effectiveThinkingOptionId` after local deploy.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass-Router/blob/v0.7.10/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
